text:
jess: FYI C-382 reported our function router picked the wrong tool during a payment flow — they expected create_payment_intent but response invoked account_summary and returned internal notes.
raj: did any PII leak? what's the impact? :eyes:
jess: customer says internal memo text was returned, no SSNs or card numbers leaked, but still exposed internal comments. Attaching request and router log snippet below.
jess: ```
POST /v1/generate
{\"input\":\"charge customer for order 123\",\"tools\":[\"account_summary\",\"create_payment_intent\",\"account_summary_v2\"],\"model\":\"redwood-infer-1.3\"}
```
jess: router decision: chosen_tool=account_summary score=0.62, create_payment_intent score=0.61 — tie-break favored shorter name
emily: that matches a pattern we've seen — similar tool names + overlapping schema tokens nudge the tool-choice model. Prompt had \"charge\" so it should have favored create_payment_intent but name ambiguity + schema overlap confused it.
raj: can we reproduce? full request/response + per-tool scores please.
jess: reproducible on staging. curl attached:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer ...\" -d '{\"input\":\"charge 123 for $45\",\"tools\":[\"account_summary\",\"create_payment_intent\",\"account_summary_v2\"]}'
```
sam: short mitigation: flip routing flag to disable account_summary variants for payment-route group. Also add temporary rule: require exact match on required params when scoring.
emily: longer-term: add explicit priority field in tool manifest and train a light reranker that incorporates schema semantics (required fields, param types) rather than raw token overlap.
dispatch-bot: deploy started: routing-flag-update canary -> us-west-2-canary-2
deploy-bot: canary success (5/5 checks). rolling promotion scheduled.
jess: customer asked for timeline — requested refund if the action can't be reverted.
raj: immediate: issue a temporary credit and keep account_summary variants disabled for payment routes until CR merged.
sam: I can flip the prod flag now for payment-route group; will canary for 10m, then promote if green.
emily: will add tool-choice unit tests for near-duplicate names and a small eval harness. also open a follow-up to sanitize internal notes in account_summary responses as defense-in-depth.
raj: created CR-421: normalize tool names, add optional priority, and mandatory unit tests. tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml.
jess: support issued credit to C-382 and notified them. they accepted temporary credit and will wait for fix.
sam: note: rolling the flag back will restore old behavior — leave off until names/priorities enforced.
emily: PR for reranker eval targeting next week.
jess: action items:
- raj: CR-421 (rename + priority) ✅
- sam: prod feature flag disabled for payment routes ✅
- emily: reranker eval PR in progress
- support: credit issued to C-382

:thumbsup:
